headlines.title_zh: 不断发展的金属提取工艺
headlines.event_summary_zh: 金属行业之前经历过变革时刻：贝塞麦工艺、闪速熔炼、电弧炉和现代连续铸造都改变了一切可能。然而，一个多世纪以来，大多数提取过程都依赖于冶金学家熟悉的技术和途径
headlines.event_summary_en:
The metals industry has experienced transformational moments before: the Bessemer process, flash smelting, electric arc furnaces, and modern continuous casting all changed what was possible.

Yet, for more than a century, most extraction processes rely on techniques and pathways that would be familiar to metallurgists from generations ago. Processes have become larger and control systems smarter, but the fundamental science behind separating metals from ores has changed less than many realize.

titans.quote_zh:
人们应该始终掌控未来。

OpenAI 反对这样一种观念，即人们被降级到做“人工智能系统认为对人类有意义的奖励”的事情是可以接受的。

titans.quote_en:
People should always be in control of the future.

OpenAI is against the notion that it would be acceptable for people to be relegated to a role of doing things that “AI systems think makes sense to reward in humans”.

People should not cede control of the future to superintelligence, and that requirement should ultimately constrain AI progress.

Universal Agent Compatibility: Plugs into terminal coding agents to ensure high-craft visual delivery
